user.description: Get the username, password and inverter ID from Qilowatt. Select a detected inverter. The credentials are checked against the Qilowatt broker before the entry is created.

secondary.title: Additional inverters
secondary.description: If you have more than one inverter of the same type running in parallel behind one grid connection, select the others here. Their grid power, current and energy are summed with the primary inverter, PV strings and batteries are reported as additional units, and the combined system is sent to Qilowatt as one device. Leave empty for a single-inverter setup.

reauth_confirm.title: Qilowatt rejected the MQTT credentials
reauth_confirm.description: The Qilowatt broker refused the stored username and password for inverter {inverter_id}. Enter the current credentials from Qilowatt.

error.invalid_auth: Qilowatt rejected the username or password
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Qilowatt broker. Check the network connection and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log

abort.already_configured: This Qilowatt inverter ID is already configured
abort.no_devices_found: No supported inverter integration was found. Set up your inverter integration first, then add Qilowatt.
